items.q: Our new assistant, Joan has been really very helpful.

ctx.x: Only as a digital download? OK.

Hopefully in the future if things go well I’ll record an album for Golden Beams and E1 with the group. We hope to be touring some of the festivals with both bands so Lydia’s been my business advisor. She’s amazing. She’s great. Our new assistant, Joan has been really very helpful. We’re looking to a pretty exciting next year.
Well, the year is going to really be launched when you receive the NEA Jazz Masters Award at the ceremony.
